title: Credit Rating Analyst - India Roadmap 🏛️
description: A comprehensive roadmap for a career in Credit Rating Analysis in India.

nodes.label: What is a Credit Rating Analyst?
nodes.description:
A Credit Rating Analyst evaluates the creditworthiness of companies, banks, NBFCs, and government bodies issuing debt. The output of this evaluation is a credit rating (AAA, AA, BBB, D).

Analysts work mainly in SEBI-registered Credit Rating Agencies like CRISIL, ICRA, CARE Ratings, and India Ratings.

nodes.label: Core Responsibilities
nodes.description:
• Analyze financial statements: leverage ratios, profitability, DSCR.
  • Assess business risk, competitive position, management quality.
  • Build projections & stress-test scenarios.
  • Prepare rating reports & present to Rating Committee.
  • Do ongoing surveillance for upgrades/downgrades.
  • Meet CFO/CEO teams for discussions on performance.

nodes.label: The 4 Cs of Credit
nodes.description:
Analysts use the classic 4 Cs:

  • Character: Governance, transparency, track record.
  • Capacity: Cash flows & debt servicing ability.
  • Capital: Net worth, leverage strength.
  • Collateral: Assets backing the debt.

nodes.label: Educational Requirements
nodes.description:
A strong background in accounting and corporate finance is essential.

  • CA (Highly preferred)
  • MBA Finance (Top B-schools)
  • CFA (Especially Levels 1 and 2)

nodes.label: Technical Knowledge Required
nodes.description:
• Financial reporting standards (Ind-AS/IFRS)
  • Corporate finance & valuation
  • Fixed income basics: bonds, debentures, CP, NCDs
  • Understanding cash flow drivers

nodes.label: Regulatory Framework (SEBI & RBI)
nodes.description:
• SEBI Credit Rating Agencies Regulations, 1999
  • RBI guidelines for bank exposures
  • Disclosure norms, compliance requirements

nodes.label: Useful but Non-Mandatory Certifications
nodes.description:
• NISM-Series-III-A (Compliance focus)
  • Internal CRA training modules
  • CFA Fixed Income modules

nodes.label: Financial Analysis Skills
nodes.description:
• Reading balance sheet, P&L, and cash flow statements
  • Debt analysis: maturity profile, interest cost, covenants
  • Ratio analysis: DSCR, Debt/EBITDA, coverage ratios

nodes.label: Industry & Macro Skills
nodes.description:
• Sector specialization (Infra, Power, Real Estate)
  • Understanding interest rate impacts
  • Regulatory environment knowledge (RBI/SEBI/MCA)

nodes.label: Communication Skills
nodes.description:
• Writing rating press releases
  • Defending ratings in committee
  • Conducting structured management interviews

nodes.label: Gaining Practical Experience
nodes.description:
• Corporate lending teams in banks
  • Credit teams in NBFCs
  • Fixed income research at AMCs
  • Audit/Advisory (Big 4)

nodes.label: Career Path Inside CRAs
nodes.description:
Typical growth:

  • Trainee
  • Associate Analyst
  • Analyst
  • Senior Analyst
  • Associate Director
  • Director / Head of Ratings

nodes.label: Exit Options
nodes.description:
• Fixed Income Portfolio Manager
  • Credit Risk roles in banks/NBFCs
  • Corporate Banking RM
  • Treasury & Debt Capital Markets roles
